paragraphs: Rav Anan. Elijah accompanied him, Ketubbot 105b–106a. A man brought fish; Anan refused on learning he had a lawsuit. The man waived Anan as judge and asked him to accept, lest he be prevented from offering first-fruits. Anan accepted the gift and sent him to Rav Naḥman, explaining his disqualification. Naḥman assumed kinship and placed the case before an orphan case already pending. Seeing the man's honor, the opposing litigant could not argue. Elijah withdrew because of this. Anan fasted and prayed; Elijah returned but terrified him. Anan made a box and sat before Elijah until Elijah finished teaching him: Seder Eliyahu Rabbah, learned outside the box, and Zuta, inside. He wore black garments for Sabbath cooking, Kol Kitvei 119a. He wrote to Rav Huna, addressing him as 'our colleague,' to collect a woman's tenth-share property provision. Rav Huna sent Rav Sheshet to ask 'Anan, Anan: land or movables? And who sits first at the mourning house?' Anan complained to Mar Ukva, Ketubbot 69a. He and Rav Ḥanan traveled, Kiddushin 39a; see Rav Ḥanan. In ר״א's name [provisionally R. Eliezer]. Rav Naḥman addressed him as Mar, citing his Shemuel report versus 'our colleague Huna' reporting Rav, Ḥullin 56a. Why Mar? Rav Naḥman was Rav Huna's colleague, while Rav Huna angrily objected to Rav Anan's calling him colleague. Rav Naḥman said, 'When you were at Mar Shemuel's,' Kiddushin 21b. He cited Rav, Shabbat 12b; end of Berakhot 4; Jerusalem Talmud, Kirah's beginning and Yesh Muttarot's end. Shemuel spoke to him, Kiddushin 39a; Yevamot 83b. He cited Shemuel, Shevuot 40b; Ḥullin 4b, 38a [source label 38יא]; Yevamot 97a. He heard Mar Shemuel, Gittin 44b, and dismantled a side-post Shemuel had permitted for Ivot bar Ihi, Eruvin 74b. (Rav) Anan bar Taḥlifa, to Rav Yosef: I did not find their conversation, but Sanhedrin 97b has Rav Ḥanan bar Taḥlifa send to Rav Yosef. Perhaps Ḥanan is an error for Anan, since no other Shas mention occurs; which, Heilprin suggests, is why Yuḥasin omitted the name Ḥanan. He often stood before Shemuel, Pesaḥim 101a; Ketubbot 61a; Shemuel explained it personally, Mo'ed Katan 18a. If this Taḥlifa was Rav Huna's father, Huna being before Rava, how could his son Rav Anan be before Shemuel? Requires examination.
